content.text: {"predictors": [{"name": "Supplier Concentration Fragility", "construction": "Using footnote disclosures in 10-K filings (SFAS 131 segment/customer data) and the Compustat Segment file, count the number of major customers accounting for >10% of a firm's revenue. Construct a Herfindahl index of revenue concentration across disclosed major customers. Firms are sorted each June on this concentration index.", "rationale": "Firms dependent on a few large customers face idiosyncratic demand-shock risk that is imperfectly priced, and the market underreacts to the fragility of concentrated revenue streams until shocks materialize.", "higher_returns_for": "high customer concentration (compensation for bearing customer-specific risk)"}, {"name": "Working Capital Acceleration", "construction": "For each firm-quarter, compute non-cash working capital = (current assets - cash) - (current liabilities - short-term debt), scaled by total assets. Compute the second difference (acceleration) over the trailing four quarters: change in the year-over-year change of scaled working capital. Sort stocks each quarter.", "rationale": "Accelerating working capital signals deteriorating operating efficiency and aggressive accrual buildup beyond simple accrual levels, which the market fails to fully discount.", "higher_returns_for": "low (negative) working capital acceleration"}, {"name": "Intra-Year Earnings Volatility Trend", "construction": "Using quarterly EPS over the trailing eight quarters, compute the standard deviation of the four most recent quarterly earnings surprises minus the standard deviation of the prior four. A positive value indicates rising earnings noise. Sort stocks each quarter on this change in earnings dispersion.", "rationale": "Rising quarter-to-quarter earnings instability reflects increasing fundamental uncertainty and lower earnings quality that investors underweight relative to point-estimate surprises.", "higher_returns_for": "low (declining) earnings volatility trend"}, {"name": "Order Flow Persistence Signature", "construction": "Using daily TAQ trade data, classify trades via the Lee-Ready algorithm into buyer/seller initiated. Compute the first-order autocorrelation of daily signed order-flow imbalance over the trailing 60 trading days. Sort stocks monthly on this autocorrelation.", "rationale": "Persistent one-sided order flow indicates gradual informed accumulation or distribution not yet reflected in price, predicting continuation.", "higher_returns_for": "high positive order-flow autocorrelation combined with net buying"}, {"name": "R&D Reinvestment Momentum", "construction": "From Compustat, compute the trailing three-year growth rate of R&D expense scaled by sales, and separately the two-year change in gross margin. Rank firms on the interaction: high R&D-intensity growth accompanied by improving gross margins. Form the composite score annually each June.", "rationale": "Rising research investment that coincides with margin expansion signals successful innovation whose payoff the market underappreciates due to R&D's delayed, uncertain returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high R&D growth paired with improving margins"}, {"name": "Debt Maturity Wall Proximity", "construction": "From Compustat, compute the fraction of total long-term debt scheduled to mature within the next two years (using debt-maturity structure items dd1, dd2). Interact with the firm's interest coverage ratio. Sort firms annually, isolating those with a high near-term maturity fraction and weak coverage.", "rationale": "Firms facing imminent refinancing needs bear rollover and credit-spread risk that is undercompensated during calm periods and severely penalized in stress, generating a risk premium.", "higher_returns_for": "high near-term maturity fraction with weak coverage (refinancing risk premium)"}, {"name": "Analyst Coverage Breadth Change", "construction": "Using I/B/E/S, compute the twelve-month change in the number of unique analysts issuing estimates, scaled by firm size decile. Focus on the residual change after controlling for size and past returns. Sort stocks monthly.", "rationale": "Increasing analyst attention reduces information asymmetry and expands the investor base, predicting positive returns as the stock is gradually incorporated into more portfolios.", "higher_returns_for": "increasing analyst coverage breadth"}, {"name": "Capitalized Operating Lease Intensity Shock", "construction": "From 10-K lease footnotes, capitalize future minimum operating lease commitments (discounted at 8%) to build an adjusted asset base. Compute the year-over-year change in capitalized-lease-to-total-adjusted-assets. Sort firms annually on this change.", "rationale": "Rapid expansion of off-balance-sheet lease obligations increases hidden operating leverage and financial fragility that standard leverage measures miss, and is undervalued as risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high increase in capitalized lease intensity (hidden leverage risk premium)"}, {"name": "Seasonal Sales Dispersion", "construction": "Using quarterly sales over the trailing five years, compute each firm's seasonal concentration as the Herfindahl index of the four calendar-quarter sales shares. Then compute the deviation of the most recent year's seasonal pattern from the historical average. Sort stocks quarterly on this seasonal-pattern deviation.", "rationale": "Departures from a firm's established seasonal sales rhythm signal changing demand conditions that investors, anchored to historical seasonality, are slow to price.", "higher_returns_for": "positive deviation (recent sales stronger than seasonal norm)"}, {"name": "Insider Trading Cluster Divergence", "construction": "From SEC Form 4 filings (Thomson Reuters insider data), compute the net dollar value of open-market insider purchases minus sales over the trailing six months, scaled by market cap. Separately measure the dispersion of directions across distinct insiders. Rank firms with strong net buying and high insider agreement (low dispersion).", "rationale": "Consensus buying across multiple insiders conveys stronger private information about undervaluation than isolated trades, predicting positive future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high net insider buying with strong cross-insider agreement"}]}
